subject: Redwood discovery follow-up: procurement & security qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Owens <jenna.owens@stellarnetworks.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery follow-up: procurement & security qualification

Hi Jenna —

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our call: 

- Recap: Stellar is evaluating Redwood for inference on customer-facing features (low-latency chat + embeddings). You run a centralized procurement process for vendor onboarding.
- Procurement path: can you confirm whether you prefer PO (standard) vs corporate card for initial pilot? Also approximate timeline for PO approval (typical company lead time).
- Commercial path: are you interested in an AWS Marketplace listing (makes procurement easier) or will you go via a direct contract + PO?
- Security gating: I’ve attached our SOC 2 (Q4 2026) and a draft DPA. Please confirm if SOC 2 + signed DPA suffice, or if you need us to fill your security questionnaire.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_Q4_2026.pdf (PDF), Redwood_DPA_draft_2027.docx (DOCX)

Proposed next steps: 
1) You confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and timeline.
2) If PO: please send your PO template and any contract redlines. If card: we can enable a 30-day trial on card while legal reviews the DPA.
3) I’ll send an official commercial quote and a short SOW for the pilot so procurement can review costs.

If it helps, I can loop in our legal (Vivek) and security lead (Nikhil) to accelerate DPA/questionnaire responses once I have your template.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Mobile: (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference runtime
From: Jenna Owens <jenna.owens@stellarnetworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@stellarnetworks.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery follow-up: procurement & security qualification

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary, that looks right from our side. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement path: We prefer PO for any vendor expected to be on our platform long-term. For a short pilot we can use a corporate card, but procurement will usually insist on PO for production/committed spend.
- Timeline: Our procurement lead estimates 3–4 weeks for a standard PO + contract review. If legal has significant redlines it can stretch longer.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace would help speed procurement approval, but that’s not a blocker for us. If Redwood can support listing, we’d be happy to go that route.
- Security gating: We need your SOC 2 (received) and a redlineable DPA. We also attached our security questionnaire — we usually ask vendors to complete it; turnaround expectation is 5 business days for straightforward items.

I’m attaching our PO template and the completed (high-level) security questionnaire for your team to fill out.

Attachments: Stellar_PO_template.pdf, STN_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Can you also share a high-level quote for a 3-month pilot (approx 50k tokens/day, mix of embedding + chat) and any reserved capacity pricing if we commit? If you can get that quote to us this week we’ll feed it to procurement.

Thanks — Jenna
Jenna Owens
Procurement Manager | Stellar Networks
jenna.owens@stellarnetworks.com

To: Jenna Owens <jenna.owens@stellarnetworks.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood discovery follow-up: procurement & security qualification

Thanks Jenna — super helpful. Looping in our legal (Vivek) and security (Nikhil) to triage the DPA + questionnaire. Quick plan from our side: 

- Commercial quote: I’ll generate a 3-month pilot quote (50k tokens/day) with an optional reserved capacity SKU for committed throughput and send by end of day Thursday. Link to the draft pricing in our system: https://app.redwood.ai/pricing/quote?deal=HS-45321
- Legal / DPA: Vivek will pick up the DPA redline and can accept a PO on our standard SOW + DPA combo. Vivek — if you see any Material Changes please flag.
- Security questionnaire: Nikhil — can you take the questionnaire (STN_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx)? We’ll return answers + any supporting artifacts within 5 business days.
- Marketplace: We can start the AWS Marketplace enablement in parallel but note there’s a ~2 week listing lead time once we have the commercial terms. If Stellar prefers this route we’ll prioritize.
